A '''Massassi enforcer blade''' was a two-handed [[Sword/Legends|sword]] used by the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] for close combat.<ref name="SWG:MEB" /> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the dark spirit of [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] used a Massassi enforcer blade to fight a group of spacers who attacked the [[Cult of Exar Kun]] in the [[Temple of Exar Kun]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="SWG:EK">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=heroic|Exar Kun}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Massassi enforcer blade appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MEB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Massassi enforcer blade was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Exar Kun|"Exar Kun" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:EK" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 9 Notes for April 3 2008|"Chapter 9" update]], on [[April 3]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67688&month=042008|text=Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun}}</ref>
